verdict.rationale: RevenueCat's first-party docs describe an official MCP server that lets AI assistants manage subscription apps, Products, Entitlements and related configuration without the dashboard. An AI Toolkit for connecting your own coding agent and setting up projects, apps, Offerings and Packages backs this up. missing for 10: details on connection and setup (hosted endpoint vs local, transport, authentication scopes), the full tool list including read access to customer or metrics data, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
